data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 降魔雷光神圣制裁
data.description: 【姬岛朱乃 · 降魔雷光神圣制裁】幽暗雷云密布的神社上空，朱乃展开一对由堕天使羽翼与雷电符文交织的黑色神圣羽翼。她身着纯白绯袴巫女服，单手虚引苍蓝色的狂暴神圣雷光，黑色高马尾在雷霆风暴中高高扬起，嘴角勾起一抹令人战栗的从容微笑——「啊啦啊啦……竟敢在神社里撒野，准备好接受雷光的净化了吗？」
data.location: 电闪雷鸣的神社鸟居上方高空
data.action: 展开堕天使黑翼悬停半空，单手引落万丈雷光，眼神从容中透着致命威严
data.lighting: 撕裂夜空的苍蓝雷电强光与幽暗背景
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, dramatic storm perspective
data.promptProse: Suspended amid a raging nighttime thunderstorm above a traditional shrine, Akeno Himejima unleashes celestial judgment. A pair of feathered black fallen-angel wings spread wide from her back while blinding azure lightning crackles around her raised hand. Her flowing miko robes and sleek black ponytail billow dramatically. With a chillingly composed smile in her violet eyes, she commands the storm. Dynamic low-angle anime key visual, solo 1girl, no text.
